attorneys: Aaron Sapiro and Charles P. Scully for petitioners. Edmund G. Brown, Attorney General of California, and William E. James and Norman H. Sokolow, Deputy Attorneys General, for respondent.

opinions.text:
Supreme Court of California. Certiorari denied. Bail having been temporarily granted in this case by Mr. Justice Douglas on April 29, 1958, it is ordered that said order continue until June 23, 1958, and then terminate.

The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
